title: JAK'D Chubby Treatz Gold Bar 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Chubby Treatz Gold Bar from Jak’d conjures the flavour of a comforting, crumbly biscuit coated in a sweet caramel icing. Created for vapers who seek a powerful flavour punch, Jak'd from the legendary Jak’d Rabbit brand delivers far more than ordinary e-liquid. Each bottle of Jak’d contains a double-concentrated shot of flavour, ensuring an intensely delicious and satisfying vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts differ from regular freebase e-liquids due to their alkaline formulation, allowing for a higher nicotine concentration. The nicotine from Nic Salt e-liquids is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings. The unique magic of Nic Salts means that you’ll enjoy a super-smooth, comfortable throat hit despite the higher nicotine concentration.
